content.title: THE MINERALS YOUR BODY IS QUIETLY {{BEGGING}} FOR
facts: **Chromium** (Blood Sugar Balancer) — Broccoli | Grapes | Barley | Turkey
**Selenium** (Cell Shield) — Brazil Nuts | Tuna | Sunflower Seeds | Turkey
**Manganese** (Bone Architect) — Pineapple | Brown Rice | Chickpeas | Cloves
**Calcium** (Skeleton Keeper) — Tofu | Kale | Sesame Seeds | Almonds
**Magnesium** (Nerve Calmer) — Black Beans | Swiss Chard | Almonds | Figs
**Follow along** — for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Let's break down a few of these. **Chromium** works behind the scenes to help insulin bind to your cells more efficiently, so glucose gets pulled out of your bloodstream instead of lingering around and causing that shaky, crashy feeling an hour after eating. **Iodine** is the raw material your thyroid uses to make T3 and T4, the hormones that set your body's entire metabolic pace — run low, and you can feel cold, foggy, or drained no matter how much you sleep. **Zinc** fuels the production of white blood cells and the enzymes involved in tissue repair, which is why a gap can quietly show up as cuts that heal slowly or colds that hit more often than they should. Everyone's baseline is different, so listen to what your own body is telling you.

At @smarthealthfix, we break things down across nutrition, common health issues, organs & body functions, and the small daily habits that tie it all together. Our mission is to help you understand what your body actually needs, instead of guessing.
